  "description": "Royal Resource Digital Services is a creative agency helping businesses grow through modern web design, branding, and digital marketing.&nbsp;

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Creative&nbsp;&nbsp;Content Strategist (Real Estate)&nbsp;

Job Location: Kaduna
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role


	Are you a creative thinker who can turn ideas into engaging content that attracts attention and drives results?
	We are looking for a talented and innovative **Creative Content Strategist** to lead content creation and digital storytelling for a growing real estate company in Kaduna.
	The ideal candidate understands modern content trends, is comfortable using AI tools, can create compelling videos and graphics, and knows how to build an engaging online presence that generates leads and brand awareness.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and execute content strategies across social media platforms
	Create engaging short-form video content for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and YouTube
	Design high-quality graphics and marketing materials
	Write compelling captions, scripts, and marketing copy
	Plan and manage content calendars
	Cover property inspections, client testimonials, and company events
	Create content that generates engagement, inquiries, and sales leads
	Monitor content performance and recommend improvements
	Stay updated on social media trends, AI tools, and content marketing innovations
	Collaborate with sales and marketing teams to support business objectives


Requirements


	Proven experience in content creation, social media management, or digital marketing
	Strong graphic design skills
	Strong video creation and editing skills
	Knowledge of Canva, CapCut, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar tools
	Familiarity with AI-powered content creation tools
	Excellent storytelling and creative thinking abilities
	Strong written and verbal communication skills
	Ability to work independently and meet deadlines
	Good understanding of social media algorithms and content trends


Preferred Skills:


	Experience creating content for real estate, hospitality, lifestyle, or related industries
	Photography and videography skills
	Experience with Meta Ads and content-driven lead generation
	Knowledge of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Runway, Veo, Gemini, or similar platforms


What We&#39;re Looking For


	Creative and innovative mindset
	Strong visual storytelling ability
	AI-savvy and future-focused
	Detail-oriented and organized
	Results-driven and proactive
	Passionate about creating content that performs
	Candidates residing in Kaduna will be given preference.


Benefits


	Competitive salary (Salary: N80,000 - N100,000 per month.)
	Opportunity to work in a fast-growing real estate company
	Exposure to modern marketing and AI tools
	Career growth and development opportunities
	Creative freedom to execute ideas.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their updated CV, Portfolio or links to previous work (if available), a brief cover note explaining why they are a good fit to: Royalresourcemanagement@gmail.com using &quot;Creative Content Strategist &ndash; Kaduna&quot; as the subject of the mail.&nbsp;

Note


	For more Information, WhatsApp on 09046575527
	Candidates residing in Kaduna will be given preference.

Creative Content Strategist (Real Estate) Job at Royal Resource Digital Services




        
    

        
        Royal Resource Digital Services is a creative agency helping businesses grow through modern web design, branding, and digital marketing. 

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Creative  Content Strategist (Real Estate) 

Job Location: Kaduna
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role
     

            
    




	Are you a creative thinker who can turn ideas into engaging content that attracts attention and drives results?
	We are looking for a talented and innovative **Creative Content Strategist** to lead content creation and digital storytelling for a growing real estate company in Kaduna.
	The ideal candidate understands modern content trends, is comfortable using AI tools, can create compelling videos and graphics, and knows how to build an engaging online presence that generates leads and brand awareness.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and execute content strategies across social media platforms
	Create engaging short-form video content for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and YouTube
	Design high-quality graphics and marketing materials
	Write compelling captions, scripts, and marketing copy
	Plan and manage content calendars
	Cover property inspections, client testimonials, and company events
	Create content that generates engagement, inquiries, and sales leads
	Monitor content performance and recommend improvements
	Stay updated on social media trends, AI tools, and content marketing innovations
	Collaborate with sales and marketing teams to support business objectives


Requirements


	Proven experience in content creation, social media management, or digital marketing
	Strong graphic design skills
	Strong video creation and editing skills
	Knowledge of Canva, CapCut, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar tools
	Familiarity with AI-powered content creation tools
	Excellent storytelling and creative thinking abilities
	Strong written and verbal communication skills
	Ability to work independently and meet deadlines
	Good understanding of social media algorithms and content trends


Preferred Skills:


	Experience creating content for real estate, hospitality, lifestyle, or related industries
	Photography and videography skills
	Experience with Meta Ads and content-driven lead generation
	Knowledge of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Runway, Veo, Gemini, or similar platforms


What We're Looking For


	Creative and innovative mindset
	Strong visual storytelling ability
	AI-savvy and future-focused
	Detail-oriented and organized
	Results-driven and proactive
	Passionate about creating content that performs
	Candidates residing in Kaduna will be given preference.


Benefits


	Competitive salary (Salary: N80,000 - N100,000 per month.)
	Opportunity to work in a fast-growing real estate company
	Exposure to modern marketing and AI tools
	Career growth and development opportunities
	Creative freedom to execute ideas.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their updated CV, Portfolio or links to previous work (if available), a brief cover note explaining why they are a good fit to: [email protected] using "Creative Content Strategist – Kaduna" as the subject of the mail. 

Note


	For more Information, WhatsApp on 09046575527
	Candidates residing in Kaduna will be given preference.

Automobile Engineer Job at African Industries Group (AIG)




        
    

        
        African Industries Group (AIG) is a diversified global conglomerate with a legacy of 52 years of business excellence and sustainable growth. It is headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria. It has been contributing to Nigeria’s socio-economic growth and industrial development and is equally committed towards the nurturing and development of the local community.

AIG owes its success to the core philosophy of ‘Building the Future Together’. Its business strategy is inclusive, sustainable, and not only benefits stakeholders but also positively impacts the environment and society.
     

            
    



It has been predominantly a manufacturing company, with operational excellence benchmarked to global standards. The group has around 35 state of the art manufacturing plants and facilities located in various locations across Nigeria, creating employment opportunities. Its investment and expansion in manufacturing with the latest functional technology provides long term employment to thousands of Nigerians, for people from across the globe. It also creates ancillary employment for many more.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Automobile Engineer

Job Location: Ikorodu, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities


	Manage maintenance of forklifts, loaders, trucks, trailers, company vehicles, diesel generators, and material handling equipment.
	Develop preventive maintenance schedules for all fleet and mobile equipment.
	Diagnose engine, hydraulic, transmission, electrical, and mechanical faults.
	Monitor fuel consumption and improve fleet efficiency.
	Reduce vehicle downtime and maintenance costs.
	Maintain vehicle service records, licensing, insurance, and statutory compliance.
	Coordinate spare parts planning and workshop operations.
	Ensure safety compliance for drivers and operators.
	Train operators on daily equipment inspection and safe operation.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree, Higher National Diploma or OND in Automobile Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline.
	4 - 8 years of experience maintaining industrial fleets or heavy equipment.
	Experience in a manufacturing, engineering, industrial, or fleet management environment is highly preferred.
	Hands-on experience with diesel engines, hydraulics, forklifts, loaders, trucks, generators, and diagnostic tools.
	Strong planning, troubleshooting, and cost-control skills.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Automobile Engineer" as the subject of the email.

Facility Officer Job at Ecofitness




        
    

        
        Ecofitness is a fast-growing fitness centre established in 2021 with branch networks in the two major cities in Nigeria; Abuja and Lagos, with a vision to extend her tentacles across the 36 states of the federation and the world at large.

We offer bespoke services developed to meet your needs with close supervision and training by our best-in-class, hand-picked and experienced fitness Trainers. With the host of our other fun and engaging fitness programs such as; Football, Lawn tennis and Basketball, We have our Trainers anchor over 16 different fitness classes per week. These include, but are not limited to; AEROBICS, HIIT, CARDIO, YOGA, DANCE etc
     

            
    



We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Facility Officer

Job Locations: Wuse and Maitma, Abuja (FCT) 
Employment Type: Full-time

Duties and Responsibilities
Facility Maintenance and Operations:


	Ensure all equipment, utilities, and infrastructure are in proper working condition.
	Oversee the daily operations and maintenance of the gym facility.
	Conduct regular inspections of gym equipment, workout areas, locker rooms, and common areas.
	Coordinate preventive maintenance schedules for gym equipment and facility assets.
	You shall supervise the cleaners and their jobs and ensure that the facility, including workout areas, and common spaces, are well-maintained and clean.
	You shall supervise the securities and ensure that they are carrying out their duties diligently.


Health, Safety, and Compliance:


	Ensure the facility complies with health, safety, and hygiene standards.
	Implement and monitor safety procedures within the facility.
	Ensure emergency equipment and safety measures are functional and accessible.
	Report and document any incidents, hazards, or maintenance issues.


Cleaning and Housekeeping Oversight:


	Supervise cleaning staff and ensure high standards of cleanliness across the facility.
	Monitor cleaning schedules for gym floors, equipment, restrooms, locker rooms, and reception areas.
	Ensure adequate cleaning supplies and materials are available.


. Vendor and Contractor Coordination:


	Liaise with external vendors and service providers for facility repairs and maintenance.
	Supervise contractors during maintenance or installation works.
	Ensure vendors adhere to agreed service standards and timelines.


Inventory and Asset Management:


	Monitor the condition and usage of gym equipment and facility assets.
	Track facility supplies and ensure timely replenishment.
	Maintain records of maintenance activities, repairs, and equipment servicing.


Member experience Support:


	Promptly address facility-related complaints or issues raised by members or staff.
	Ensure the facility environment is welcoming, safe, and conducive for members.


Qualifications


	Interested candidates should possess a Bachelor`s Degree with 2 - 4 years of experience. 


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Applications to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.
